history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration call upon the related governing bodies to ensure that the accountability system and a tracking mechanism are well in place so that the expected efficiency agenda is achieved in a timely and accountable manner.
history.administration_response: The Development Coordination Office fully embraced the Board’s recommendation and has heavily invested its resources in developing and implementing a reporting system that tracks the results achieved by United Nations entities and Business Innovations Group teams. An efficiency dashboard was launched in August 2023 and is publicly available. The system reports on all four pillars of the Efficiency Agenda and complements the common premises platform launched in August 2022. The Development Coordination Office proposes that the Board close this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the efficiency agenda and the related annual targets have been adjusted in the revised efficiency road map for the period 2022–2024, the Board considers this recommendation as having been overtaken by events.
